name: tori-v2 face
units: px on the 1024x1024 source canvas (y down); continuous coords, pixel k covers [k, k+1)
placement: for slot s and part p: image top-left = s.anchor - p.anchor (if s.mirror: flip the image horizontally and use anchor x = p.w - p.anchor[0]); the result is a child of 'head' at rest canvas coords, i.e. apply the head's world matrix from rig.json (step5_rig.world_matrices) exactly like head.png.  Slots of the same type share images: eyes are NEVER mirrored (the highlights must be identical), brows ARE mirrored for browR.
zOrderNote: draw right after head-blank (all above the head), mouth below nose (philtrum tucks under it)

headBlank.note: replaces head.png when the face parts are drawn (same box, same pivot)

slotNotes.eyeL/eyeR: eye centres (alpha centroid of the disc).  eyeR = measured; eyeL snapped by +0.39,-0.04 px so the shared image lands on whole pixels
slotNotes.browL/browR: brow centres (alpha centroid).  browR uses the mirrored image, snapped to whole pixels
slotNotes.mouth: top-centre attach point under the nose = philtrum axis x at the nose/philtrum split row; every mouth image's anchor is the top of its philtrum (the first 6 rows tuck under the nose)

eye-open.source: EXACT crop of the original viewer's-right eye (big white highlight upper-left, small white highlight lower-right); used for BOTH eyes, never mirrored

brow-neutral.source: EXACT crop of the original viewer's-left brow; right brow = mirrored

nose.source: EXACT crop of the original nose (down to the philtrum)

mouth-neutral.source: EXACT crop of the original philtrum + w smile

eye-surprised.source: measured eye geometry (disc + both highlights, original colours) re-rendered x1.12

eye-blink.source: AI sheet ai-eyes-1 cell 2 centreline (symmetric 4th-order fit), depth capped (gentle), re-stroked: span = eye diameter, width = mouth line, eye dark brown

eye-happy.source: AI sheet ai-eyes-1 cell 3 centreline (symmetric fit), re-stroked: span = eye diameter, width = mouth line, eye dark brown

eye-sad.source: eye-open (exact) + tear-shine crescent from AI sheet ai-eyes-1 cell 5 (flat highlight white)

brow-angry.source: exact brow-neutral rotated to +16 deg tilt (inner end down), shifted +2 px

brow-sad.source: exact brow-neutral rotated to -26 deg tilt (inner end up), shifted -1 px

brow-worried.source: exact brow-neutral rotated to -24 deg tilt (inner end up), shifted -8 px

brow-raised.source: exact brow-neutral rotated to -13 deg tilt (inner end up), shifted -10 px

mouth-smile-open.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 2: keyed, scaled x0.5464 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-talk-s.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 3: keyed, scaled x0.5464 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-talk-m.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 4: keyed, scaled x0.5464 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-talk-l.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 5: keyed, scaled x0.5464 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-sad.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 6: keyed, scaled x0.5408 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-angry.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 7: keyed, scaled x0.5408 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-o.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 8: keyed, scaled x0.5464 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

mouth-ee.source: AI sheet ai-mouths-1 cell 9: keyed, scaled x0.5408 (AI nose/mouth width -> original), lines re-stroked at 6.49 px, straight philtrum, flat original colours

metrics.eyeHighlightNote: offsets from the eye centre; identical in both eyes (one image). The original left eye had a small BROWN dot (not white) at lower right ([20.21, 18.738] from its centre); both eyes now use the right eye's white one (the rule)
metrics.lineThicknessNote: original mouth line (philtrum) width = sum of alpha across the line; used for every re-stroked mouth line and the blink/happy eye lines

browTiltDeg.note: angle of the outer->inner end axis, + = inner end lower (L brow)

metrics.browNote: the original brows are thicker than the mouth line; all brow variants are the exact original brow (rotated/raised) so they keep its thickness

blankHead.method: per-class Gaussian normalised convolution of the surrounding flat colours; tan forehead wedge continued under the nose
